patch_description: Replace independent source-to-destination shortest paths with a cost-aware directed multicast tree. The new search first removes unusable, unpriced links and then repeatedly attaches the remaining destination with the cheapest path from any node already reached by the broadcast tree. This allows destinations to reuse previously selected transit trunks, reducing redundant inter-cloud transfer charges while retaining valid per-destination ordered paths for every partition. The deterministic tie-breaker prefers higher-throughput branches when branch costs are equal, improving the ability to overlap transfers without sacrificing billing cost.
